title: Atomic Chat Provider Registry
description: Schema for the remote provider registry consumed by the Atomic Chat (Jan) client.

schema_version.description: Bump this when the shape of a provider entry changes in a backwards-incompatible way.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; refresh on every meaningful change.

api_key.description: MUST always be an empty string. API keys are stored locally and never live in the registry.

provider.description: Stable, unique provider id. Lowercase, no spaces.

supports_model_listing.description: Controls the client's Refresh (↻) button. true or absent: show the curated registry list UNION the provider's live GET /v1/models. false: show the curated registry list only and skip the live probe (use when /v1/models returns hundreds of junk/internal model ids).

keyCheck.description: Optional. The request the client sends, with the user's key, to check that key on Connect, instead of GET {base_url}/models. Set it only for a provider whose model list answers without a valid key, and only to a documented endpoint that requires a valid key and costs nothing to call. Any 2xx means the key works; a 401 means it is invalid. Exactly one of `path` or `url`.

path.description: Joined onto base_url, e.g. "/key" for https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key.

url.description: An absolute HTTPS URL, for an endpoint outside base_url. Its host must be base_url's host or share its parent domain (CI checks this); the client also skips it when the user has changed base_url to another host, so a key is never sent elsewhere.
